description_zh: 查询资源容量统计信息
name: DescribeCapacityInfo

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the business chain to query
parameters.name: biz_chain_id

CapacityQuota.description_en: The capacity quota of the business chain. Unit: bytes
CapacityQuota.description_zh: 该业务链的容量配额（单位：字节）

CountQuota.description_en: The record count quota of the business chain

MemberUsedCapacity.description_en: The capacity used by the current user on the business chain. Unit: bytes
MemberUsedCapacity.description_zh: 当前用户在该业务链已使用的容量（单位：字节）

MemberUsedCount.description_en: The number of records used by the current user on the business chain
MemberUsedCount.description_zh: 当前用户该业务链已使用的条数

UsedCapacity.description_en: The capacity used by the business chain. Unit: bytes
UsedCapacity.description_zh: 该业务链已使用容量（单位：字节）

UsedCount.description_en: The number of records used by the business chain

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
Message.example: The system is busy. Please try again later.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
